author: Pete Nakos
title: Judge grants Trinidad Chambliss preliminary injunction against NCAA, Ole Miss QB eligible to play 2026 season - On3
description: Judge William Liston has ruled on Ole Miss quarterback Trinidad Chambliss' preliminary injunction against the NCAA.
content: Ole Miss quarterback Trinidad Chambliss has been granted a preliminary injunction against the NCAA, making him currently eligible for the Rebels 2026 season until the lawsuit is fully litigated. Judg… [+3009 chars]
